title: SL5 Explorable — Simulation Configuration
description: Formulas and parameters that drive the simulation engine

scoring.description: How the overall SL score is computed

category_weights.description: Relative importance of each category in harmonic mean (must sum to 1.0)

sl_scale_mapping.description: Maps raw score (0-100) to SL equivalent (1.0-5.0)

breach_probability.description: How breach probability is calculated per adversary per chain

model.description: chain_max: P(breach) = max P(chain) across all viable chains. chain_aggregate: 1 - product(1 - P(chain))

effective_oc_formula.description: How effective OC is computed for a given block and year

oc_to_success_probability.description: Maps (effective_oc - block_oc_threshold) delta to exploitation probability

sigmoid_midpoint.description: At delta=0 (adversary exactly at threshold), probability is 50%

defense_in_depth_discount.description: How multiple layers reduce breach probability

per_additional_layer_factor.description: Each additional independent layer multiplies breach probability by this factor

correlation_penalty.description: Shared dependencies between layers reduce the discount by this amount per shared dependency

block_maturation.description: How blocks progress from decision to deployment over time

deployed_to_mature_months.description: Additional months after deployment to reach full maturity/effectiveness

partial_effectiveness.description: Block effectiveness while not yet fully deployed

distillation_model.description: Continuous extraction accumulator for models served externally

enabled.description: Whether the model is served externally (false = air-gapped = no extraction risk)

base_extraction_rate_per_month.description: Fraction of model capability extractable per month with basic distillation (2026 baseline)

ai_efficiency_multiplier_at_full.description: How much AI capability multiplies extraction rate (at AI capability = 1.0)

defense_effectiveness.description: How deployed inference-channel blocks reduce extraction rate

compromise_threshold.description: Extraction fraction at which model is considered effectively stolen

inbound_attack_model.description: Risk accumulator for attacks THROUGH the inference channel (inbound)

enabled.description: Whether the model accepts external input (false = air-gapped)

base_exploitation_probability_per_month.description: Monthly probability of successful exploitation via inference channel (2026 baseline)

ai_amplification_at_full.description: How much AI capability multiplies inbound attack success rate
